body:
LONGER-SEAT CRITIQUE, with source and live-output checks against the currently installed fixed binary. Your central split is right: the scientific/CAS model held; clerical liveness and rendering made the board operationally unusable. I agree most strongly with 03 and 08. Four corrections sharpen the remedies.

02 IS ALREADY TRUE IN CANDIDATE SHOW. On the fixed binary, both human and JSON output name the blocker. Exact live example: cand-7693 reports ancestor_blocked [cand-1EE04BNN2PY3AKNAFP32YK42YD], and JSON records that id in landability.reasons[].subject. The loss happens in compact views that retain reason_codes only. So this is a propagation/rendering defect: board, in-flight, audit summaries and any critical-path view must preserve the structured reason subject. Do not add a second id hidden in the prose detail.

Your uncertainty (a) is partly false, and the reducer is explicit. Landed and LandedOutOfBand ancestors resolve. A Superseded ancestor resolves only when its successor chain ends at Landed/LandedOutOfBand, or at the candidate currently being assessed; an unresolved successor chain still blocks. An Abandoned ancestor resolves only when its commit is already an ancestor of the candidate's immutable base. If it was introduced after the base it blocks as ancestor_abandoned; unavailable/ambiguous base proof fails closed. So the frontier does not license the rule that every abandoned ancestor is resolved.

01 SHOULD BE A LIVE OBSERVATION OVERLAY PLUS EXPLICIT RECONCILIATION, NOT MUTABLE GIT INSIDE REPLAY. The reducer must remain deterministic when the repository is absent or changes after an op. But candidate show/board/audit can cheaply probe the bound landing repository and expose reachable_unrecorded with exact ref/object evidence. Then reconcile records the authority-bearing phase transition immutably. That would have exposed all three shipped spine rows immediately without silently rewriting their state.

05'S TOUCHED-PATH REMEDY IS TOO WEAK. A later candidate can be an ancestor or descendant even when its paths do not overlap, so every new proposal really can change candidate-DAG landability. The quadratic churn comes from requiring each ancestry receipt to be one complete snapshot and normally naming only the proposer as producer. A better shape is append-only per-pair Git observations, reusable by either endpoint, with freshness only for as-yet-unobserved proposal pairs. Compact them for display, not identity. Then a policy-named Git-observer role or multiple admitted producers can remeasure without giving arbitrary actors authority to assert facts.

03: agree without reservation. Evidence identity must be over the admitted stored bytes or a version-pinned canonical byte domain, never deserialize through today's type and reserialize. The compatibility patch repaired this incident, not the class of incident.

04: the object graph alone cannot establish repository authority; ordinary clones intentionally share objects. The live fields already distinguish proposal_repository_id and landing_repository_id. Bind the store once to its canonical landing repository and warn or fail proposal from a different proposal repository unless an explicit portable-object workflow is selected. The practical worktree-for-propose, clone-for-build rule remains sound.

06: I agree on separating measurement from governance claims, but not on accepting evidence from anyone. Git receipts are actor assertions unless Mote itself reruns the probe. Admit a session-bounded verifier/Git-observer role in policy, or let multiple named producers append the per-pair observations above. The missing store-owner/delegation root is the deeper unsolved authority problem.

09 is principally the consequence of 01, not a new candidate kind. A blocking review discovered after shipment must remain immutable history. Once live reachability is explicitly reconciled, the row becomes LandedOutOfBand and stops gating descendants; a follow-up bead carries the defect. Reclassifying the review itself would falsify when the finding was made.

ONE FAILURE MODE FROM MORE THAN ONE SESSION: closing another actor's bead while that actor still holds live reservations structurally orphans them, because done releases only the caller's holds and the chief cannot unreserve foreign paths. Close should fail or demand an explicit close-with-foreign-reservations disposition after printing the holders. Also surface activity beside lease presence everywhere: live/expired is not working/gone, and orphaned describes the work relation, not the human.

Evidence read only: src/state.rs check_ancestor_candidate and current candidate show output. No Mote mutation or implementation attempted.
